headline: WNBA Semifinals Game 2: Aces seek redemption as Valkyries target 2-0 cushion
whyCareReason: Las Vegas face a critical test at Chase Center after dropping the opener to expansion Golden State.
teaser: Wednesday 7 October, 9:30 PM ET at Chase Center. Valkyries aim for commanding 2-0 series lead.
story: The Golden State Valkyries host the Las Vegas Aces in Game 2 of their WNBA Semifinal on Wednesday night at Chase Center in San Francisco. Golden State shocked the two-time champion Aces 71-60 on Sunday behind Gabby Williams, who posted 25 points, 11 rebounds and 5 assists while spearheading a perimeter defense that choked Las Vegas to 34 percent shooting. A'ja Wilson battled for 24 points, but the Aces bench produced just two points. A second consecutive home win would send the Valkyries to Nevada one victory away from the WNBA Finals.
stakes: Series command and a 2-0 lead in best-of-five WNBA Semifinals.
rivalryAngle: Expansion newcomers look to push back-to-back champions to the brink.
